default_stop: If minimal witness exists, GRRL/grammar repeats, and no R3 read or representation breakpoint appears, seal O_(n+1) as FRONTIER_REPEAT_CANDIDATE and stop. Do not generate a broad population.
nonclaims: no automatic graduation from one witness
no geometry from graph statistics alone

exclude: f has a symbolic update law
a topology-aware quotient can retain f but existing actions still factor through q_n
operational_read_definition.formal: A candidate intrinsic function f is operationally read at O_n iff there exist exact states x,y with q_n(x)=q_n(y) and f(x)!=f(y), plus an admitted frozen action/context a, such that enabledness, action multiplicity/label, or q_n-visible successor relation differs. Merely adding f to an observer does not count as a read.

per_level_sequence: P0_PARENT_PIN: resolve the certified O_n authority and frozen action/observer law
P1_MINIMAL_EXISTENCE: construct the smallest genuine O_(n+1) retained-relation witness; no population census
P2_GRRL_GATE: check H1-H13/reopen conditions and normalized grammar delta
P3_INTRINSIC_FUNCTION_SCAN: evaluate only the registered candidate relational functions on a tiny adversarial witness panel
P4_OPERATIONAL_READ_GATE: distinguish observer visibility from an action actually reading the function
P5_REPRESENTATION_GATE: detect any new state field, relation arity, orientation/order, deletion/rewiring, multiplicity or quotient requirement
P6_STOP_OR_ESCALATE: repeat -> seal compact result and advance; read/break -> open a targeted programme around the exact separator
purpose: From O8 upward, maximize scientific information per generated byte by inheriting certified recursive law and spending compute only on existence, theorem breakpoints, representation changes, and newly operational intrinsic reads.
